## v1.2.1 — 2026-10-02

**Emoji now display correctly, in the Twemoji style used by Discord.**

### ✨ Highlights

- **No more empty boxes** — Newer emoji such as 🥲 🥹 🫠 🫨 used to appear as empty boxes on Windows 10. InstaDesktop now ships its own emoji font, so they display everywhere: messages, posts, comments and the emoji picker.
- **Twemoji style** — Emoji use the same Twemoji designs as Discord on desktop, instead of the dated Windows 10 designs.

### 🛠️ Improvements

- Only emoji change. Ordinary text keeps its usual Windows font.
- Flags, skin tones and combined emoji (such as 🏳️‍🌈 ❤️‍🔥 👩🏽‍💻) display as one emoji.
- The font is built in and loads locally; nothing is downloaded while you use Instagram.

### 🔄 Updating

Existing users can simply launch InstaDesktop. If an update is available, the app downloads the latest installer from this Release and upgrades automatically.

Manual installation is also available:

1. Download **`InstaDesktop-Setup.exe`** below.
2. Run it; your profile and custom `Assets` are preserved.

### 📦 Downloads

| File | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `InstaDesktop-Setup.exe` | Recommended per-user Windows installer |
| `SHA256SUMS.txt` | SHA-256 checksums for downloaded files |

### ✅ Verification

- Windows 10/11 x64
- Microsoft Edge WebView2 Evergreen Runtime
- Automated: the bundled emoji font loads on instagram.com in WebView2
- Checked against Instagram's own emoji picker fonts: no empty boxes, ordinary text unchanged

### ⚠️ Known Issues

- About 19 of the newest emoji (Unicode Emoji 17 and 18, released 2025–2026) are not drawn by Twemoji yet and still use the Windows display.
- Keycap emoji (1️⃣ #️⃣) keep the Windows design so ordinary digits are never affected.
- When Instagram only shows "N new messages" for a conversation, the notification shows that summary instead of the text.
- Turning off **Allow camera** during a call also interrupts that call's audio; Instagram can request the microphone again without a new prompt.

### 🔐 Security & privacy

No credentials or profile data are included in release assets. Update downloads use HTTPS from this repository's Releases, and the installer's SHA-256 is verified before execution.
